text: Code reviews are an essential part of modern software development. When developers review each other's code before it is merged, they can catch bugs early, which saves time and money later. Code reviews also encourage knowledge sharing, because team members learn from each other's ideas and techniques. In addition, regular reviews help maintain a high level of team quality, since everyone follows the same standards. Although code reviews take extra time, they are worth the effort. They improve communication, reduce mistakes, and build a stronger, more confident team. For these reasons, every development team should treat code reviews as a normal and valuable habit.
